title: Push your project to GitHub
why_it_matters: It's your backup, your portfolio and your deploy source.
explanation: Create an empty repo on GitHub, then link it as origin. The -u flag on the first push remembers the branch, so later you can just type git push. Commit your work first, since push sends commits, not edits.
code:
git remote add origin git@github.com:YOUR-USERNAME/YOUR-REPO.git
git push -u origin main
try_it: Push a small project and open the repo page to check.
